hero_headline: A Look Back at May at Den 1880, Plus What’s Ahead for Our Coworking Community
intro_paragraph: As we step into a new month at Den 1880, our vibrant coworking community is still buzzing from an exciting April. From engaging events to exciting new members and partnerships, our coworking space continues to grow as a hub for creativity, collaboration, and connection in Uptown Waterloo.
